newsitem.title: FRANCE: France, Germany in broad accord on Europe-Chirac.
newsitem.headline: France, Germany in broad accord on Europe-Chirac.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac, speaking three days ahead of a special EU summit to discuss European reform, said on Tuesday that France and Germany were in broad agreement on the issues involved.

He said after a meeting with German Chancellor Helmut Kohl that the two had talked about preparations for the summit on Friday in the Dutch town of Noordwijk that will look at European enlargement and institutional reform.
"We reviewed virtually all of the issues," Chirac told a news conference.
"The positions of France and of Germany are very broadly convergent in the context of this preparation," he said.
